history.titleAfter: , resilience and the will to create.
paragraphs: It all began in the 2000s, when Carlos Garcez, then a sales representative, met Oebier dos Santos, responsible for packaging approval at Tigre Tubos e Conexões. Many trips, many visits — and a friendship that became a partnership.

Oebier introduced his brother Alexandre dos Santos, and the trio was formed. Between 2008 and 2010, Alexandre established residence in Porto Velho to serve Camargo Corrêa projects on the Rio Madeira. Carlos organized purchases from the South. Oebier joined the trips. The idea of entrepreneurship grew with every conversation.

In 2010, Carlos was diagnosed with lymphoma. Two years of treatment. But the idea never stopped. At a dinner during treatment, Carlos presented the project to his friend Robson, who joined the group as an investor.
In 2013, Dutex Indústria Plástica was born. In 2018, Carlos, Alexandre and Oebier acquired 100% of the company — and the story continues.
history.quote: While I was in treatment, I thought: if this passes, I'll build something that lasts. Dutex is that — built against all odds.

timeline.title: The trio forms
timeline.description: Carlos Garcez meets Oebier dos Santos at Tigre. Oebier introduces his brother Alexandre. Three friends, one shared calling.

timeline.title: Porto Velho & Rio Madeira
timeline.description: Alexandre moves to Rondônia to serve Camargo Corrêa projects. Carlos develops suppliers in the South. The entrepreneurship project takes shape.

timeline.title: Diagnosis & Resilience
timeline.description: Carlos receives a lymphoma diagnosis. Two years of treatment. The idea doesn't stop — at a dinner, Robson is introduced to the project and decides to invest.

timeline.title: Dutex is born
timeline.description: After many meetings, Dutex Indústria Plástica is founded in Garuva, SC. From the idea gestated in Porto Velho to the first injection machine turned on.

timeline.title: 100% founder-owned
timeline.description: Carlos, Alexandre and Oebier acquire 100% of the company. Dutex becomes Dutex Industrial — integrated steel, plastic and logistics.

timeline.title: And the story continues…
timeline.description: ISO 9001:2015, closed loop with Brazil's largest steel companies, and a new expansion phase underway.

culture.titleBefore: What we believe — and how that
culture.intro: Eight beliefs that aren't on a wall. They're on the factory floor, in client conversations and in every technical decision.

beliefs.title: Solve before selling
beliefs.description: Solving is the priority — not the product. We eliminate risk, reduce loss, improve operations. If it doesn't solve, it doesn't serve.

beliefs.title: Efficiency over ego
beliefs.description: Simple process, fast decisions, zero noise. Efficiency operates first; ego stays outside.

beliefs.title: Trust in the details
beliefs.description: From PP to steel, everything follows standards. ISO 9001:2015 isn't a badge — it's daily discipline.

beliefs.title: Clarity always wins
beliefs.description: Predictability over guesswork. We explain, align, deliver. Always.

beliefs.title: Innovate to solve
beliefs.description: Innovation isn't fluff. It's practice: real pain → real technical solution. Engineering, prototype, test, validation.

beliefs.title: Responsibility for impact
beliefs.description: Every piece protects people, avoids cost, improves operations. The impact exists — and the team knows it.

beliefs.title: Partnership over transaction
beliefs.description: Client, supplier, carrier, operator. We work together. We win together.

beliefs.title: Growth with courage
beliefs.description: Better before bigger. Courage to see what the industry will only notice tomorrow.

mvv.title: Mission, Vision & Values
mvv.mission: To provide innovative solutions, products and services, while committing to society and the environment.
mvv.vision: Expand the portfolio of products, services and projects to achieve planned revenue, with a focus on profitability, sustainability and quality of work life.
mvv.qualityPolicy: Dutex is committed to society, the environment and the quality of its products and services — meeting applicable requirements and seeking continuous improvement in every process.

esg.titleBefore: Their steel becomes a solution that protects…
esg.paragraph1: Dutex operates in a closed loop with Brazil's largest steel companies. We buy their plastic waste, transform it into protection and logistics products, and return it as a solution — reducing emissions, eliminating landfill and generating efficiency across the entire chain.
esg.paragraph2: The vast majority of our logistics products use recycled PP. Where the technical application requires greater strength or purity, we use virgin PP — because load performance and safety are non-negotiable.
esg.callout: client waste becomes Dutex raw material — which becomes a product that returns to the client.

cases.title: Engineering that solves. Projects that prove it.
cases.intro: Every project starts with a real problem. The result is always the same: less damage, lower cost, greater operational reliability.
cases.footnote: * Cases presented anonymously due to client confidentiality policy.

items.challenge: Recurring damage to coil edges during internal movement and transport — generating rework and scrap on the production line.
items.solution: Development of co-extruded corner protector with TNT reinforcement, specified for the client's coil weight and format.
items.result: Significant reduction in logistics damage and greater stability in stacking.

items.challenge: Use of disposable wooden cradles for heavy coil support — high recurring cost, low durability and waste generation.
items.solution: Design and manufacture of custom reusable metal cradles, sized for coils from 3 to 20 tons.
items.result: Service life up to 10× longer than the previous solution, with elimination of recurring disposal cost.

items.challenge: Need for custom sheets and blanks with ZC/FF/FQ surface quality — short lead time and strict technical specification.
items.solution: Own slitter and cross-cutting, integrated production of blanks to the required standard, with traceability and quality inspection.
items.result: On-time delivery with certified material — no intermediary, no rework.

cta.description: Our engineering evaluates your application and proposes the ideal technical solution — at no cost, no commitment.
